rationale: Matches the ToRef trait contract and precisely states that the returned reference has the same deep view as the receiver. This is the strongest sound postcondition expressible with the existing vstd DeepView vocabulary (pointer identity is not asserted).
risks: Relies on the correctness of HashMap::deep_view and the DeepView implementations for K and V; if those are unsound (e.g., produce collisions), the semantic equality claim could be misleading.
Does not assert physical pointer equality—only semantic equality of deep views.
